request.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one exceptionally sharp, high-resolution 4K vertical 4:5 editorial photograph for Playbook, an adult entertainment-literacy campaign. Clean photograph only, no typography or graphic overlays. It illustrates friends making room for another plan in their evening. Contemporary hospitality editorial, lived-in and confident, beautiful but believable. The interaction must tell a specific story before any copy is added. Composition for an existing cover is critical: the upper 35 percent is uninterrupted quiet dark architecture, without faces, lights, bright sky strips or strong edges. All faces fall between 40 and 58 percent down the image, the key gesture between 55 and 71 percent. Lower 24 percent is a naturally simple low-detail foreground with visible texture, no essential hands or bright objects. The photograph reaches all four edges continuously; no artificial vignette, dark rectangular bands, border or inset. Medium environmental framing from several paces away, natural 50mm perspective, approximately f/5.6, both people's eyes, skin, hair, hands and fabric sharply resolved. Warm directional light and subtle fill make both faces luminous without a flat flash. Preserve realistic skin texture, slight asymmetry, fine lines, natural hair and fabric weave. No haze, motion blur, heavy bokeh, fake grain, smoothing, waxy skin or painterly texture. Two clearly adult friends in their late 30s to early 50s with individual style and real rapport; relaxed clothes, not formal luxury costumes. A quiet navy/forest architectural background, warm amber practical light and a restrained rust accent. No alcohol, cash, chips, game equipment, readable signs, phones, screen interfaces, logos, text or watermark. They are engaged with one another, not posing for the camera or sharing a smile toward the same off-camera point. Show the chosen scene with honest anatomy and natural hands. SCENE: Adult friends heading out together for late food on a contemporary pedestrian street at blue hour. A Black woman in her late 30s with natural short curls and a matte rust jacket walks beside an East Asian man in his early 40s with short dark hair and a dark olive overshirt. Their heads are about 44 and 48 percent down the frame. They are turning into a small warmly lit restaurant entrance at middle-right; she looks at him mid-story and he responds with a small amused smile, one natural conversational hand gesture around 64 percent down the frame. The entrance and one subtly visible empty dining table beyond it communicate the next plan without signage. Quiet charcoal brick and a deep navy awning occupy the entire upper 35 percent; no bright street lights or sky stripe there. Subtle cobalt ambient light stays on the background and pavement, while warm doorway light models both faces naturally. A slightly more energetic urban moment but freeze their motion crisply. The lower 24 percent is simple dark pavement and relaxed clothing; no bright road markings or dominant objects behind future copy. Keep natural perspective and strong optical detail. No youthful streetwear exaggeration, neon slogans, cars, pedestrians covering the subjects, shopping bags or giant advertising signs.
